scenes.caption: Behind every reply, powerful chips in a data centre are doing the work.
The IEA expects global data centre electricity use to more than double by 2030.
Power use by AI-focused servers is projected to grow about 30% a year.
India is building its own AI computing capacity, fast.
Each new generation of chips does more work for every unit of energy.
Smaller, smarter models can answer many questions with far less computing.
And when data centres run on clean power, every answer gets cleaner.
With India's solar and wind growing fast, AI can grow green.

sources: IEA, Energy and AI (2025): data centre electricity ~415 TWh (2024) to ~945 TWh (2030); accelerated-server electricity use growing ~30% a year (base case)
Government of India: IndiaAI Mission, ₹10,371.92 crore (2024)
MNRE: solar 164.6 GW, wind 58.1 GW installed as of 31 July 2026
